description: Upcoming dated catalysts (unlocks, emission steps, votes, launches) across the Book, soonest first, at most 20. Optional token slug, tokens (several slugs), kind and horizon in days (default 30, max 180). Text is analyst notes; each event also has symbol, kind, estimated (date marked approximate), a short title, and the measured next unlock (pct_circ, pct_supply, tokens, source, as_of; CoinMarketCap) when it falls within a day of the event, else null. Events with title 'Scheduled unlock' come from the measured schedule alone, fill only slots the analyst events leave free, and are counted in scheduled_total.

tokens.description: Several token slugs, e.g. the coins a person follows.
